root_cause.text: In `rose_kill_by_device()`, the for-loop iterating over collected sockets uses the total count `cnt` as the index into the local array instead of the loop variable `i`, causing reads from uninitialized or out-of-bounds entries and subsequent invalid socket dereferences.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `sk = array[cnt];` to `sk = array[i];` in the loop (line 208), and both the CVE description and commit message confirm that the erroneous index `cnt` leads to undefined behavior and reference leaks.
